name: Rotting Curse
body:
School transmutation [curse, evil]; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 6, lathspell 4, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, spiritualist 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The vile curse causes the subject’s flesh and bones to rot. On a failed saving throw, the subject takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage immediately, and a further 1d6 points of Constitution damage every hour until the subject dies or the curse is removed with a break enchantment, wish, miracle, or remove curse spell or any other spell capable of removing curses. The subsequent Con damage can be reduced to 1 by a successful Fortitude save. If the target succeeds on their initial saving throw they take 1 Con damage and the curse is thwarted.
